batman: A city is worth saving one quiet act at a time.
Courage is what remains when the shadows answer back.
Tonight, someone gets to walk home without fear.
superman: The strongest thing we can lift is someone else’s hope.

There is always time to help one more person.
joker: A perfectly sensible plan could use a little confetti.

wonder-woman: Strength means little unless it makes room for compassion.
Truth is a bridge we build by having the courage to listen.
Let the shield protect a stranger before the sword settles an argument.
flash: The best reason to hurry is someone who needs you.
Even the fastest day has room for one patient conversation.
I cannot outrun every mistake, but I can choose my next step.
green-lantern: Willpower begins with one small promise you decide to keep.

nightwing: A leap is easier when you know who will catch you.

red-hood: A second chance should come with a door that actually opens.

constantine: If the shadows offer you a bargain, read the small print twice.

rorschach: Rain washes the pavement. The choices remain.

doctor-manhattan: Among all the arrangements of matter, a shared moment remains remarkable.
